hook: Google DeepMind ka chhappan ghante ka AI course, bilkul free.

beats.narration: Google DeepMind ka chhappan ghante ka AI course, bilkul free.
beats.claim: AI Research Foundations is a free 56-hour program from Google DeepMind.

beats.narration: Isme sikhate hain large language models kaise banate hain aur fine-tune kaise karte hain.
beats.claim: The curriculum covers building and fine-tuning large language models and conducting AI research.

beats.narration: Course Google Skills pe hai. Poora karne pe Google Cloud ke skill badges aur certificate milte hain.
beats.claim: It is offered on Google Skills; learners can earn Google Cloud skill badges and certificates.

beats.narration: IISc Bangalore isse already use kar raha hai, aur NASSCOM ise Future Skills Prime pe laayega.
beats.claim: IISc Bangalore has started using it; NASSCOM will make it available through Future Skills Prime.

beats.narration: Resume pe AI likhna hai? Pehle ye chhappan ghante.

title: Google DeepMind ka 56 ghante ka AI course, bilkul free
description: AI Research Foundations by Google DeepMind on Google Skills: LLM building aur fine-tuning, badges aur certificate ke saath. Link: https://skills.google/paths/3135
